knowledge:
- key_parameters: set=Input dataset, which can be a GenomicRatioSet (for methylation), ExpressionSet (for expression), or SummarizedExperiment ;; model=A formula or design matrix representing the linear model to fit ;; variable_names=Character vector of the primary variable(s) of interest in runPipeline ;; covariable_names=Character vector of covariates to adjust for in runPipeline ;; sva=Logical indicating whether to run Surrogate Variable Analysis to correct for hidden batch effects or inflation ;; betas=Logical indicating whether to use Beta values (TRUE) or M-values (FALSE) for methylation analysis ;; rid=Character or numeric index specifying which analysis result to extract from a ResultSet (e.g., "DiffMean", "DiffVar", "RDA") ;; coef=Numeric vector indicating which coefficient(s) to evaluate in getProbeResults ;; range=A GRanges object specifying the genomic region of interest for regional analyses (RDA, plotRegion)
- alternatives: minfi or lumi for raw preprocessing of Illumina methylation microarrays ;; limma (internally wrapped by runDiffMeanAnalysis) for standard differential expression/methylation ;; missMethyl (internally wrapped by runDiffVarAnalysis via varFit) for differential variability ;; bumphunter, blockFinder, and DMRcate for finding differentially methylated regions (DMRs) ;; vegan (internally wrapped by runRDA) for redundancy analysis
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing Illumina HumanMethylation (450K/EPIC) arrays and/or gene expression microarrays (or RNA-seq summarized as ExpressionSets) to find differential features, regional methylation changes, or to correlate methylation with nearby gene expression.
- pitfalls: Inflation of p-values (S-shape in QQ-plot, lambda != 1) often occurs if key covariates (like cell type proportions or batch effects) are omitted; use SVA (sva = TRUE) to correct this ;; GRanges objects passed to plot for highlighting/subsetting must have chromosomes coded as numbers (e.g., "11" or "23" instead of "chr11" or "chrX" in some plotting contexts, though plotRegion accepts standard "chr" prefixes) ;; Input data must be preprocessed; MEAL does not perform raw normalization.

workflows.name: methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform genome-wide differential methylation mean and variance analysis on preprocessed methylation data.
workflows.stages: 1. Run the analysis pipeline using runPipeline ;; 2. Extract results using getAssociation, getProbeResults, or getGeneVals ;; 3. Visualize results using plot (Manhattan, Volcano, QQ-plots), plotFeature, or plotRegion.
workflows.code:
resAdj <- runPipeline(set = meth, variable_names = "status", 
                      covariable_names = "age", analyses = c("DiffMean", "DiffVar"))
names(resAdj)
head(getAssociation(resAdj, "DiffMean"))
head(getAssociation(resAdj, "DiffVar"))
head(getProbeResults(resAdj, rid = 1, coef = 2:3, 
                     fNames = c("chromosome", "start")))
getGeneVals(resAdj, "ARMS2", genecol = "UCSC_RefGene_Name", fNames = c("chromosome", "start"))
targetRange <- GRanges("23:13000000-23000000")
plot(resAdj, rid = "DiffMean", type = "manhattan", highlight = targetRange)
plot(resAdj, rid = "DiffMean", type = "manhattan", subset = targetRange)
plot(resAdj, rid = "DiffMean", type = "manhattan", suggestiveline = 3, 
     genomewideline = 6, main = "My custom Manhattan")
abline(h = 13, col = "yellow")
plot(resAdj, rid = "DiffMean", type = "volcano", tPV = 14, tFC = 0.4, 
     show.labels = FALSE) + ggtitle("My custom Volcano")
plot(resAdj, rid = "DiffMean", type = "qq") + ggtitle("My custom QQplot")
plotFeature(set = meth, feat = "cg09383816", variables = "status") + 
  ggtitle("Diff Means")
plotFeature(set = meth, feat = "cg11847929", variables = "status") + 
  ggtitle("Diff Vars")
targetRange <- GRanges("chrX:13000000-14000000")
plotRegion(resAdj, targetRange)
plotRegion(resAdj, targetRange, results = c("DiffMean"), tPV = 10)

workflows.name: expression_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression analysis on an ExpressionSet.
workflows.stages: 1. Run differential mean analysis using runDiffMeanAnalysis ;; 2. Evaluate model fit and visualize results using QQ-plots, Volcano plots, and Manhattan plots.
workflows.code:
gexpRes <- runDiffMeanAnalysis(set = brge_gexp, model = ~ sex)
names(gexpRes)
plot(gexpRes, rid = "DiffMean", type = "qq")
plot(gexpRes, rid = "DiffMean", type = "volcano") + ggtitle("Differences in Means")
targetRangeNum <- GRanges("11:102600000-103300000")
plot(gexpRes, rid = "DiffMean", type = "manhattan", main = "Differences in Means", highlight = targetRangeNum)

workflows.name: methylation_expression_integration
workflows.intent: Integrate methylation and expression datasets to evaluate regional associations and calculate probe-level correlations.
workflows.stages: 1. Co-visualize regional results using plotRegion ;; 2. Create a MultiDataSet and add both expression and methylation datasets ;; 3. Subset the MultiDataSet to a target genomic range ;; 4. Calculate correlation between CpGs and expression probes using correlationMethExprs.
workflows.code:
plotRegion(rset = methRes, rset2 = gexpRes, range = targetRange)
multi <- createMultiDataSet()
multi <- add_genexp(multi, brge_gexp)
multi <- add_methy(multi, brge_methy)
multi.filt <- multi[, , targetRange]
methExprs <- correlationMethExprs(multi.filt)
head(methExprs)

workflows.name: regional_rda
workflows.intent: Determine if a specific genomic region is differentially methylated using Redundancy Analysis.
workflows.stages: 1. Run RDA on a target genomic range using runRDA ;; 2. Extract RDA association summaries and top hits using getAssociation, getRDAresults, and topRDAhits ;; 3. Visualize RDA dimensions and sample groupings using plotRDA.
workflows.code:
targetRange <- GRanges("chrX:13000000-23000000")
resRDA <- runRDA(set = meth, model = ~ status, range = targetRange)
getAssociation(resRDA, rid = "RDA")
getRDAresults(resRDA)
topRDAhits(resRDA)
plotRDA(object = resRDA, pheno = colData(meth)[, "status", drop = FALSE])
plotRDA(object = resRDA, pheno = colData(meth)[, "status", drop = FALSE])
abline(h = -1)
